C0276.title: Crawler Criminalization Case: Shanghai Company Convicted for Bypassing Anti-Crawling Measures to Scrape Public Data
keywords: illegally obtaining computer information system data
C0276.summary: In one of the People's Court's Top Ten Criminal Cases of 2019, Shanghai Mou Pin Network Technology Co., Ltd. was convicted of illegally obtaining computer information system data. The case established that even when scraping publicly available data, using technical means to circumvent anti-crawling protections can constitute a criminal offense, significantly impacting the determination of criminal
